content.title: Sub-Area Planning: Northwest Arvada
content.summary: The Northwest Sub-Area Plan for Arvada was approved by the City Council on June 4, 2023, serving as the guiding document for future development in the area defined by State Highway 93 to Gladiola Street, the Indiana Street corridor, and bounded by the railroad tracks to the south and the city boundary to the north. The plan aims to facilitate organized growth and development within this designated sub-area.
content.body:
![Aerial View of North West Arvada ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=177)

The Northwest Sub-Area Plan was approved by City Council on June 4, 2023. The plan will now act as the guiding document for new development in the Northwest Sub-Area generally defined as the area east of State Highway 93 to Gladiola Street, including the Indiana Street corridor, and between the railroad tracks on the south and the City boundary on the north.

[**Review the Approved Northwest Sub-Area Plan**](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68bf43b01cb8e)
